title: HARDTESTGEN: A High-Quality RL Verifier Generation Pipeline for LLM Algorithmic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2505.24098v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Verifiers provide important reward signals for reinforcement learning of large language models (LLMs). However, it is challenging to develop or create reliable verifiers, especially for code generation tasks. A well-disguised wrong solution program may only be detected by carefully human-written edge cases that are difficult to synthesize automatically. To address this issue, we propose HARDTESTGEN, an approach to synthesize high-quality test cases for algorithmic coding problems. We curate a comprehensive algorithmic programming dataset HARDTESTS with 26.6k problems and high-quality synthetic tests. Compared with existing tests, HARDTESTGEN tests demonstrate significantly higher accuracy in verifying LLM-generated code (+11.22 percentage points in precision, the percentage of actually correct code within the predicted correct ones). translated_title: HARDTESTGEN：面向大语言模型算法编程的高质量强化学习验证器生成流水线
translated_abstract: 验证器为大语言模型（LLM）的强化学习提供重要的奖励信号。然而，开发或创建可靠的验证器极具挑战性，尤其是在代码生成任务中。一个伪装巧妙的错误解答程序可能只有通过精心人工编写的边缘测试用例才能被发现，而这类用例很难自动合成。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了HARDTESTGEN，一种为算法编程问题合成高质量测试用例的方法。我们构建了一个全面的算法编程数据集HARDTESTS，包含2.66万个问题及高质量的合成测试。与现有测试相比，HARDTESTGEN生成的测试在验证LLM生成代码方面表现出显著更高的准确率（精确度提升11.22个百分点，即在预测为正确的代码中实际正确代码所占的比例）。我们还证明，下游后训练——包括拒绝采样和强化学习（RL）——（摘要此处不完整）
tldr: HARDTESTGEN提出了一种为算法编程问题自动合成高质量测试用例的流水线，并构建了包含2.66万道题的HARDTESTS数据集，其测试用例在验证LLM生成代码方面的精确度比现有测试提升11.22个百分点，有效支撑拒绝采样和强化学习等下游后训练。
en_tdlr: HARDTESTGEN introduces a pipeline for synthesizing high-quality test cases for algorithmic coding problems and curates the 26.6k-problem HARDTESTS dataset, whose tests achieve +11.22 percentage points higher precision in verifying LLM-generated code and benefit downstream post-training such as rejection sampling and reinforcement learning.
